description: This line plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the accuracy of three different models—labeled "Squared Exponential," "Tanh," and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B"—as a function of the number of demonstrations, which is plotted on the x-axis labeled "#Demonstrations" and ranges from 0 to 1500 with tick marks at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 45 to 55 and uses a linear scale. The "Squared Exponential" model is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 52.5 at 0 demonstrations and rising to a peak of about 55.5 at 250 demonstrations before leveling off near 55.5 for the remainder of the range. The "Tanh" model is shown as a solid dark blue line with circular markers, maintaining a relatively stable accuracy of approximately 48.5 across the entire x-axis range. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model is depicted by a dashed purple line with circular markers, remaining nearly constant at approximately 46.5 throughout the plot. A faint pink dashed line labeled "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" is drawn horizontally at the level of the model's accuracy, visually reinforcing its consistent performance.
